title: Chemistry 2e
description: Open introductory chemistry textbook (second edition, published 14 February 2019) read in the OpenStax web view. Chapters used by Corniversity: 1 Essential Ideas, 2 Atoms, Molecules, and Ions, 3 Composition of Substances and Solutions, 4 Stoichiometry of Chemical Reactions, 5 Thermochemistry, 6 Electronic Structure and Periodic Properties, 7 Chemical Bonding and Molecular Geometry, 8 Advanced Theories of Covalent Bonding, 12 Kinetics, 13 Fundamental Equilibrium Concepts, 14 Acid-Base Equilibria, 16 Thermodynamics, 17 Electrochemistry.
rightsNotes: The preface page viewed on 2026-10-30 states: 'Chemistry 2e is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-NC-SA) license'. The owner's brief and the earlier registry entry expected CC BY 4.0; the page as seen today says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and this record follows the page.

The same page states: 'This book may not be used in the training of large language models or otherwise be ingested into large language models or generative AI offerings without OpenStax's prior written permission.' Corniversity therefore treats the book as reference-only: the learner opens exact section pages in the browser; the worker never fetches, stores, embeds or passes OpenStax text to AI personas; lessons cite section titles and standard formula names only.

OpenStax-copyrighted images, activities and assessments carry the same CC BY-NC-SA licence; some openly licensed art must be credited to its original source; the OpenStax and Rice University names, logos and book covers are trademarks outside the licence.
Corniversity exercises are original and never copy OpenStax end-of-chapter exercises or numbered Examples; Example numbers are mentioned only to point the learner at a worked example to read.
